claim_scope: single-seed online same-distribution VDA4 competence experiment
question: Can an H-only transformer memory solve VDA4 when it may jointly attend to previous memory and current visual-transformer tokens?

architecture.memory: single transformer: Q=H_prev; K/V=[H_prev,Z]; residual=H_prev; H-only state
architecture.jepa_teacher: EMA teacher over H with temporal t-to-t+1 distillation

success_gate: Operational competence requires a healthy complete run and sustained same-distribution correctness above chance; mechanistic claims require a separate frozen attention/intervention assay.
falsifier: The registered architecture fails to improve beyond chance or is numerically/operationally unstable over the full local run.
